req.title: Reflect query parameters on GET
req.statement: The system shall include client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key of the GET /get response body.
expected_outcomes: response args field mirrors query string

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /get must reflect client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key. I designed tests covering: (1) a positive EP case with a single k=v pair asserting exact key and value; (2) a positive EP case with multiple parameters; (3) a negative path with no query parameters asserting args is an empty dict; (4) a BVA boundary case with a single-character key and empty-string value; (5) a DT case with special characters in values; (6) a NEG case verifying the endpoint rejects POST method with 405. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /get?k=v using Flask test client
expected: args dict has exactly one entry
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key mirrors query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args():
    r = client.get('/get?k=v')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert 'args' in body
    assert body['args'] == {'k': 'v'}
    assert len(body['args']) == 1

test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args()

tests.name: test_post_to_get_endpoint_returns_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint only accepts GET method
actions: Send POST /get?k=v using Flask test client
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 405 (Method Not Allowed)
Response does not contain args reflecting query params as a 200 would
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: error pathway — wrong HTTP method yields 4xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_to_get_endpoint_returns_405():
    r = client.post('/get?k=v')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
